segments.t: Cursor appearance for korTTY's file editor tabs. Open via KTPH001Configuration → Global Settings → EditorKTPH002; stored in KTPH000.
KTPH000BLOCKKTPH001 is a wide cursor (2 px), KTPH002LINEKTPH003 a thin vertical line (1 px), KTPH004UNDERSCOREKTPH005 a medium width (1.5 px).

The editor uses the same font family, font size, foreground and background colors that terminals use, so those are configured on the KTPH000AppearanceKTPH001 and KTPH002ColorsKTPH003 tabs rather than here. The KTPH004Snippet EditorKTPH005 tab can override them for snippet windows.
